source_assessment.criterion: Strict required explicit null/null or strictly ordered real UTC strings; mixed/missing/extra/type/invalid/order refusal
source_assessment.assessment: The nullable fields have no defaults and remain required. Strict/extra-forbid validation is inherited. Both-null exits explicitly; mixed values are refused before parsing; finite dates must match seconds/Z syntax, parse as real calendar instants, and have end strictly after start. The decoder checks the exact key set and uses ISO roundtrip plus strict order, rejecting rollover/year-zero/hour24/leap-second inputs. Wizard enabling uses empty choices rather than invented dates and checks locally before writing. No normalization of valid saved timestamps is introduced.

The negative node checks both POST and CAS PUT refusals, unchanged GET head and unchanged engagement/revision counts for mixed, missing, wrong-type, invalid-date, equal-order and extra-field cases. These are limits of proof, not circular SOURCE blockers.
